title: 05 Nightjar: an incident postmortem told as a comic
strengths: A believable incident told end to end in seven panels: the page at 02:14, the deploy suspect, a rollback that fixes nothing, the renamed config key and 3 s default, retries fanning 1 call into 16, the breaker, resolved at 02:47
Two inks with a rule: red appears only where something is broken, so the closing panel has none; tone is halftone dots, never gradients
Real postmortem content around the strip: window, impact (4,180 of 33,712 checkouts, 12.4%), cause, and three shipped actions with owners and dates; every panel has a text version
slop_signals: The figure drawings are crude primitives: a mitten-shaped hand on the breaker lever, a box mug in the last panel, a head drawn as a black circle with headphones; next to FREITAG's or Discord's illustration they read as clip art
The breaker panel says 'RETRY WORKER CLOSED' at the top and 'OPEN' at the lever, so the state is said two contradictory ways
fixes: Redraw the three figurative panels with an illustrator's line (weight variation, hands and objects drawn from reference), or turn them into diagram panels like the strong 02:31 one
Fix the drain arithmetic and the 'haven't moved' line (below)
Label the breaker once: 'Retry worker breaker: OPEN'

references.what: A numbered process drawn in one ink line with real figures: the bar for drawing craft
A company story told in chapters with professional character illustration
Speech balloons carrying real dialogue on a product page

changed: Retry queue drains at 4,000 calls a second: about 2.0 M at 02:36, empty at 02:44, before 02:47 resolved
Panels 1, 2 and 4 agree minute by minute (38% at 02:13); the rollback marker sits at 02:24; errors fall only to 29% and Kwame says so
02:00 settlement batch marked in panel 2 and named in the Cause row; panel 4 caption blames the queued retries; queue labelled for all ledger callers
Breaker panel redrawn as an object with no hand, labelled once, with the queue drawn draining; KA-CHUNK and OPEN no longer red
Head, headphones, mug, key legends and app arrows redrawn; text versions match the drawings; curly quotes; calmer body lettering
